title: When the Silence Breaks
author: Felix Yarrow
blurb: Petra Yarrow, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
